description: Manage the active Novel's lore entries — shared, durable world facts every caller recalls — and the knowledge corpus of cold reference material. Mutating actions (including corpus_register, corpus_route, corpus_grant, corpus_deny, corpus_access, corpus_consume) persist to the Novel and are audited; read-only actions do not mutate state. Revert the most recent mutation with manage_history (action: undo). import defaults mode to dry-run; merge or replace writes. Use when: creating, revising, removing, toggling, grouping, suggesting, listing, exporting, or importing lore, or registering, routing, granting, denying, consuming, or inspecting corpus reference material (corpus_* actions). Do NOT use when: recording a story beat — use manage_story (action: record); recording one entity's beliefs or perceptions — use manage_belief; registering a reusable gameplay artifact — use manage_codex.

action.description: Lore: set, update, remove, toggle, group, suggest, list, get, export, import, set_secret, reveal, secret_list, or knowledge. Corpus: corpus_register, corpus_list, corpus_get, corpus_route, corpus_grant, corpus_deny, corpus_access, corpus_consume, or corpus_acquisitions.

corpus_access_public.description: Whether every entity may consume it (corpus_register; default false).

corpus_domains.description: Knowledge domains the entity may access (corpus_access).

corpus_mode.description: read, research, taught, or import (corpus_consume; default read).

corpus_source_profile.description: Trusted source profile the domain is routed from (corpus_register; default manual).

entity_id.description: Entity to reveal to / whose knowledge to read (reveal/knowledge).

group.description: Group name, or null to clear (set/update/group).

name: manage_lore

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Lore Management
